tree: How can customers reschedule appointments online?
Appointment rescheduling software gives customers a link to pick a new free time themselves. The calendar updates, the team is notified and the slot is never left empty.
Rescheduling by phone takes time, and cancelled slots often stay empty.
Customers pick a new time themselves and the calendar updates instantly.
Appointment rescheduling software keeps your schedule full.
Give customers the flexibility to change their appointment time in just a few steps — anytime, on any device.
Allow customers, staff or admins to reschedule appointments based on your rules and preferences.
Choose a new date and time that works for you.
Your Wellness Consultation has been rescheduled to:
Track all rescheduled appointments with complete history, reasons and notifications in one place.
Control when and how appointments can be rescheduled.
Block changes too close to the appointment.
Everything you need to know about rescheduling appointments in Noxtill.
Give your customers the flexibility they need.
Enable rescheduling and keep your schedule full with Noxtill.
